target_customer: Fintechs and banks with KYC, AML and risk operations teams
problem: Compliance analysts spend large amounts of time on routine due diligence and on false positive sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI agents for compliance workflows; pricing not stated
product_category: AI agents for KYC and AML compliance operations

founders.name: Edoardo Maschio
prior_employers: Rocket Internet (investment associate and chief of staff, early-stage team)
founders.background_notes: Education not stated on the YC page.

founders.name: Ahmed Gaber
prior_employers: Funding Circle (technical PM and software engineer)
founders.background_notes: Education not stated on the YC page.

investors: angels including founders or CEOs of Allica Bank, N26, IDnow, Billie

competitors.name: ComplyAdvantage
competitors.what: Compliance software vendor that launched a KYB solution with automated onboarding and dynamic risk scoring for business customers

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents over sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts need accuracy, audit trails and integrations with screening providers such as LexisNexis, WorldCheck and Dow Jones, which is hard but standard applied engineering in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: Regulated customers need audit trails, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and workflow integration, which raises switching costs, and the team includes compliance veterans, but screening vendors could add similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established with dated sources. Established AML vendors exist, but this research found no source showing they copied the agent wedge.

market_need_then: AML and KYC teams faced high false positive alert volumes and rising compliance cost; the company later reports customer claims of 50 percent or more handling time reductions, which are self reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses godiligent.ai, a prefix on the .ai domain, not diligent.com.

identity.visual_style: enterprise security positioning with SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR badges
identity.voice_and_tone: professional; tagline We bring your risk and compliance ops to a new era

brand_strength.rationale: Press coverage is of the funding round, not the brand. The name is confusable with the much larger Diligent (diligent.com), which also uses Diligent AI as a product label, and with DiligentIQ.

outcome_analysis: Diligent is active and, per its own announcement, raised a 2.5M dollar seed round in March 2026 led by Speedinvest and Shapers with Y Combinator continuing. It has named fintech customers and compliance trained founders, which supports founder market fit. It is still early, so nothing is known about durability, and the earlier history from the 2023 batch to 2026 is not documented.
notes: Round confirmed by the company post and cross-checked by Tech.eu and Tech Funding News; some outlets report 2.1M euros for the same round (currency conversion). The exact day is not stated in the company text. YC page also names Chris Leow as a team member, not a founder, so he is not listed. Earlier funding in 2023 to 2025 is not documented; coverage is partial. ComplyAdvantage added from a July 18 2023 FinTech Alliance article.
